project_summary: Warehouse management system integrated with SAP

components.name: Inventory and storage locations
components.description: Bin locations, stock movements, cycle counts and putaway and picking strategies by product family.

components.name: Handheld barcode scanning app
components.description: Android app for rugged handhelds to scan barcodes during receiving, picking and shipping, working offline with later sync.

components.name: SAP integration
components.description: Exchange of purchase orders, deliveries and goods movements with SAP S/4HANA through IDocs and OData services, with error handling and replay.

components.name: Single sign-on with Azure AD
components.description: Employee login through Azure Active Directory with SAML, group-based roles and automatic deprovisioning.
